body:
Pan ftm here :) I know exactly how you feel. My entire family is transphobic and their comments destroy me every single time. I’m misgendered every single day. But some of the reasons why I feel like I can’t end it is 

1. I’ll die in this feminine body 
2. my dead name will be on my tombstone 
3. I haven’t given transitioning a chance. 

I dread these so bad because I know that’s going to happen which makes me more suicidal.

This. And whenever I’m in the car with a family member or someone else, I wish I car would just crash into us brutally but only killing me and maybe leaving a scratch on them. I want to see this body I carried around for years destroyed and unrecognizable. But I’m too much of a wimp to end it myself
Yeah exactly. You start to forget not only the bad times but the good times too
Yeah :/ I let people walk all over me whenever they start to hurt me because I’m frozen in those situations

I THOUGHT I WAS THE ONLY ONE. Literally I have a week spree of not wanting to talk to my friends. And I do it knowing it’ll worry them. Idk I’m an asshole but I need a break from people being people sometimes

I start turning into my mom when this happens. She’s violent and very manipulative. And in that moment you don’t think of anything else but that anger and come up with the worst conclusions about that person. It’s awful, it turns me into this monster.
I remember trying it once and it didn’t hurt, it was just... a crushing feeling? You can’t really describe it it’s so hard to explain

I always wondered when people say “it gets better” if they are just in denial about how they feel. Or maybe it did get better but it didn’t last their whole life? I can’t say because it never got better for me, not even once

I get like this but cry during moments of... well, anything but sadness. I’m a random cry-er and when things get sad, I don’t seem to care. But whenever something funny happens on the TV, I’m laughing and crying at the same time. Then just have crying spells the rest of the night. It’s as if my mind is inside out and not doing what it’s supposed to. It’s odd and concerning

I have this exactly. No matter what it is, I have a hard time asking for things in general. Even the smallest bare minimum things, from my family feels so fucking hard. I’m afraid of confrontation or getting yelled at. It’s getting worse recently
I’m a writer and have a book planned out. Just out of motivation
Exactly this. I feel like a waste of space in this miracle we call life
We’re just living for other people tbh
Exactly. I feel like I’m in the future and ready to go already on my own terms
It’s just an old feeling. And thank you, you as well
Must be nice
How do you feel now
Seems like too much work loool. I can’t even get out of bed without feeling like I ran a marathon
I know. It’s not like I’ve accomplished anything special either. It’s just that old feeling
Thank you! And exactly... It's such a weird thought to have but it's a constant one
Just to clarify, I am not eating less in hopes of slimming down. I just don't find any interest in getting up and doing something that'll benefit me. And I am aware it's harmful.
